scientific_limitations: Continuous restriction to a single positive orthant, pure spherical-harmonic degree one or two, every fixed ambient dimension at least 3; no higher-degree, arbitrary-cone or finite-sampling/noise theorem. Historical priority is provisional because an implicit symmetric tensor formula may exist.
title: Exact quadratic spherical-orthant concentration and a sharp dimension-squared stability law
